title: COMPASS: Routing via Capability-Oriented Model Profiling with Adaptive Search, Selection, and Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.27822v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM routing aims to select a capable model at low cost, but specialized routers can require updates as models and tasks change. We propose COMPASS, an agentic router in which an LLM follows a routing recipe, gathers performance and cost evidence through tools, and optionally inspects candidate answers before selecting a model. Our evaluations on LLMRouterBench and DeepSWE show that agentic routing can improve accuracy and lower model-call cost relative to specialized and trained routing baselines, without routing-specific training. On LLMRouterBench, COMPASS reaches 69.85% accuracy at \$139.57, compared with RLCascadeRouter's 69.14% at \$180.22. On DeepSWE under fixed five-fold cross-validation, it reaches 78.1% at \$215, compared with 74.1% at \$500 for the best single model. COMPASS also supports routing across benchmarks and adapts to an expanded model pool by reading new evaluation records, without changing the router's weights or pr

translated_title: COMPASS：通过面向能力的模型画像与自适应搜索、选择及工具使用实现大模型路由
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27822v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：大语言模型（LLM）路由旨在以低成本选出能力合适的模型，但专用路由器会随着模型和任务的变化而需要更新。我们提出 COMPASS，一种智能体式路由器，由 LLM 遵循一条“路由配方”，通过工具收集模型的性能与成本证据，并在选择模型之前可选地检查候选答案。我们在 LLMRouterBench 和 DeepSWE 上的评估表明，相较于专门设计并经过训练的路由基线，这种智能体式路由无需任何路由特定训练即可提高准确率并降低模型调用成本。在 LLMRouterBench 上，COMPASS 以 139.57 美元的成本达到 69.85% 的准确率，而 RLCascadeRouter 需 180.22 美元才达到 69.14%。在固定五折交叉验证的 DeepSWE 上，它以 215 美元的成本达到 78.1%，而最佳单一模型需 500 美元才达到 74.1%。COMPASS 还支持跨基准路由，并能通过读取新的评估记录来适应扩充的模型池，而无需更改路由器的权重或提示。
tldr: COMPASS 是一种无需路由专用训练的智能体式 LLM 路由器，通过工具收集性能与成本证据并按路由配方决策，在多个基准上以更低的模型调用成本取得更高的准确率，且能随模型池扩展灵活适应。
en_tdlr: COMPASS is a training-free agentic LLM router that follows a routing recipe and gathers performance and cost evidence via tools, achieving higher accuracy at lower model-call cost than specialized trained routing baselines while adapting to expanding model pools.
